body:
I'm ok with drones. It's both generic and specific at the same time, showing that you can use it to build your own search on any items. But I don't mind changing if you have another idea. I would not like a more generic e-commerce website, though.

Ok for the anchors as well. We need to be careful because some of the ids in the markup are used as placeholders by the instantsearch demos.

And finally, let's push it to bower, but not as the main/default way of grabbing it.
